title: Cyberbullying detection
summary: Led a 5-person team: NLTK + TF-IDF on 20K+ tweets, 4 models compared, Random Forest at 92% accuracy.
headline: Detecting cyberbullying in tweets with classic NLP
intro: My B.Tech capstone. I led a team of five to build a text classifier that flags cyberbullying in tweets.
role: Team lead: scoped the project, built the pipeline and compared the models.

sections.title: How it works
items: Cleaned and tokenized 20K+ tweets with NLTK
Turned text into features with TF-IDF
Trained and compared 4 classifiers; Random Forest reached 92% accuracy

sections.title: What's next
paragraphs: Automatically reporting flagged content was scoped as future work; the project delivered the detection model.
